headline: Committee votes to use remaining funds to buy a bench for the Community Pool renovation project.
summary: The committee heard a final financial update and voted unanimously to spend any remaining funds on a bench for the Community Pool renovation project. The bench will be named for the Wallingford Celebrates America's 250th event held June 19-21, 2026, with a plaque noting this. Roz Gallagher will meet with the Mayor before notifying Parks and Recreation, and the committee agreed this would be its final meeting.
decisions: Approved unanimously to use any remaining funds to purchase a bench for the Community Pool renovation project, named for the Wallingford Celebrates America's 250th event.
